import sys, os, hashlib
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
for k in ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'PLACE_MODEL']: os.environ.pop(k, None)
from types import ModuleType
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend')
from dealroom_sign import placement
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement_r14 import in_process
from dealroom_sign.tests import placement_r24_review_cases as R24
rc = R24.rc
src = open('/root/worktrees/send-merge/backend/dealroom_sign/placement.py').read()
assert hashlib.sha256(src.encode()).hexdigest().startswith('866637df')
assert hashlib.sha256(open(placement.__file__, 'rb').read()).hexdigest().startswith('a8ad8dcc')
live = ModuleType('live29b'); live.__file__ = placement.__file__; sys.modules['live29b'] = live
exec(compile(src, 'live29b', 'exec'), live.__dict__)
http = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('http'))
pat = dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)
with patch('httpx.Client.send', http):
    for rec in ('parsed', 'none'):
        for head in ('FLEET TEST CO.', 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS HOLDINGS, LLC'):
            row = []
            for g in (12, 16, 20, 24, 30):
                rows = [(150, 'DISCLOSER:', False, 72), (162, head, False, 72),
                        (200, 'By:', True, 72, 272), (230, 'Date:', True, 72, 272), (230 + g, 'Name: Pat Smith', False, 72)]
                pdf = rc.pages_pdf([list(rc.RECITALS[rec]), rows])
                a = in_process(live, pdf, [pat], Mock()); b = in_process(placement, pdf, [pat], Mock())
                row.append('g%d live:%s/%d r31:%s/%d' % (g, a['status'][:6], len(a['fields']), b['status'][:6], len(b['fields'])))
            print(rec, head[:22], ' | '.join(row))
print('http', http.call_count)
